summary: Use workforce data to compare capacity, cost and skills scenarios. Explore the five-day advanced HR analytics course and its practical outputs.
lede: Advanced HR analytics helps workforce teams compare capacity with changing demand and cost. For HR analysts, workforce planners and people leaders, practical work includes building Excel capacity baselines, comparing staffing scenarios, mapping skills coverage and evaluating interventions through cohort analysis, while documenting assumptions and data limitations.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with HR or workforce data and need to turn it into operational allocation choices. It is designed for intermediate-level practitioners who can interpret basic workforce reports and want to compare options with clear assumptions.
prerequisites: Prior experience working with HR or workforce data and interpreting basic workforce reports is expected. Familiarity with spreadsheet formulas and pivot tables will help you complete the Excel exercises. Coding or programming is not required; advanced modelling and AI-enabled analytics receive conceptual coverage rather than implementation training.
